content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send your application via email is 07 September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: IIT Roorkee has announced a total of 7 vacancies for various Project Positions under the QUEST Project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Positions at IIT Roorkee will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Consultant post?
faq.answer: The Project Consultant position offers a salary of Rs. 1,47,000 per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any specific qualifications required for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Yes, for the JRF position, candidates must have an M. Sc. in Physics with a valid GATE/NET qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential skills for the Project Associate(I) role?
faq.answer: For the Project Associate(I) role, programming knowledge in Python is mandatory. Knowledge of Fortran and C++ is preferred.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates should apply by sending their complete application, including bio-data and self-attested documents, via email to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation mentioned for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any such provisions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The direct link to download the official notification PDF is available in the "Important Links" section of this article.
